description: 北九州市 有料自転車駐車場利用状況 [cycling networks] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 北九州市. 有料自転車駐車場の概要、定期・普通利用者数、有料自転車駐車場の利用台数、自転車駐車場の収入額（建設局事業概要に掲載の内容）のデータです。. Coverage: 北九州市. The portal files it under the publisher 北九州市. Its tags are 一覧, 統計, 集計. It offers 8 resource(s) in pdf, xlsx. The portal shows 2025-03-28 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
